name: UPLIFT V3 Standing Desk, Bamboo 1", 80" x 30", V3 C-Frame 27.5" feet Black, Advanced Comfort Angled Keypad Black, Soft Roll Casters Black

dimensions.raw: Configurator: "UPL960-bamboo-80x30"; Desktop Style "Bamboo Bamboo 1" +$100"; Desktop Size "80" x 30" +$320"; Frame Color "V3 C-Frame 27.5" feet Black BUNDLE-FV3-200-C27B"; Casters "Soft Roll Casters Black, raises desk 2.5"". Specifications: "Frame width Adjustable from 41.3" to 72.2""; "Frame depth 27.6" for 30" deep desktops"; "Frame height (not including desktop) 21.6" to 47.7""; "Note: Casters increase desk height by 1.5" to 4.7"."; "Travel range 26.1""; "Bamboo desktops are 1" thick."; "Lifting capacity 355 lb (inclusive of desktop weights)"
dimensions.source: upliftdesk.com's V3 Standing Desk configurator and its Specifications section, read in Claude in Chrome 2026-11-08 with Bamboo 1" and 80" x 30" selected (the SKU printed under the desktop options). w 80 and d 30 are the desktop; h 51.2 is the frame's 47.7" plus the 1" bamboo top plus the 2.5" of the Soft Roll Casters in Andrew's cart (the page's own range with a 1" top is 22.6" to 48.7"; on these casters 25.1" to 51.2").

notes: In Andrew's UPLIFT cart, qty 1 (2026-11-08, his screenshots): "UPLIFT V3 Standing Desk" $1,097: Desktop Style +$100 Bamboo - Bamboo 1"; Desktop Size +$320 80" x 30"; Grommets 2 Covers - Black; Frame Color V3 C-Frame 27.5" feet - Black; Keypad +$29 Advanced Comfort Angled Keypad - Black; Casters +$49 Soft Roll Casters - Black, raises desk 2.5"; Assembly Help I don't need assembly help; free accessories Bamboo Rocker-X Board (without comfort mat), Standing Desk Mat, Bamboo Desk Drawer - Natural, Clamp-On Cup Holder - Black; free gifts Austin Tumbler - Woodgrain, Insulated Mug - Black. The page, 2026-11-08: $1,019 with Bamboo 1" and 80 x 30 on the default frame and Basic Display keypad, so the cart's $1,097 is that plus the keypad's $29 and the casters' $49 (the page lists the Soft Roll Casters at $79, $49 with a desk). The cart's coupon BF2026 takes $200 off a $1,999+ subtotal, $300 off $2,999+ ("Sale ends 11/29/2026"). The url is the configurator with Bamboo 1" and 80 x 30 selected; it carries the default keypad, not the cart's. Every V3 includes the FlexMount Cable Manager and 10 cable wraps. "Ships the same day, order by 3pm Central"; free shipping, 1-4 business days; 15-year warranty; 25,802 reviews at 4.9. Ships flat in boxes (frame box 1 47.5 x 11 x 6.75", 57.3 lb; the 28" feet 29.5 x 6 x 4.5"; the desktop's box not listed). Fit: back-bedroom, right wall, x 76-106, y 36-116 (layout i), the personal run; each side wall holds 104" between the heater line (y 12, F-33) and the wardrobe's landing (y 116, F-31), so it leaves 24"; 46" in front of it to the 60" job desk (F-35) · fits. Four 32" screens flat in a row need about 114" (F-62), so on this 80" they go two over two or three across with the outer two angled in and the fourth above. Flags: none (51.2" is under F-23's 78"; ships flat, F-22). rooms: back-bedroom, from Andrew's question.
